Name: Pokemon Eggventure - Introduction
Author: Parme69
Description:
[left][center]Start your Stardew Valley adventure with a Pokémon-inspired opening!

[/center]
[center]This mod replaces the original [b]Stardew Valley intro sequence[/b] with a custom Pokémon-themed version featuring the graceful flight of [b]Butterfree[/b] and the iconic [b]Drifloon[/b] floating through the sky.

[/center]
[center]From the very first moments of a new game, you'll be welcomed by a nostalgic Pokémon atmosphere while keeping the rest of the game completely unchanged.

[/center]
[center]The mod only modifies the introductory visuals and does not affect gameplay.


[/center]
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/0ryTJqxk/features.png[/img]

[/center]
[/left]
[center]Replaces the original Stardew Valley intro with a Pokémon-themed version.
[/center]
[center]Features Butterfree and Drifloon[/center]
[center]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6[/center]
[center]No gameplay changes[/center]
[center]Lightweight and easy to install

[/center]
[center]This mod is part of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49098][b]Pokémon Eggventure[/b] project[/url], but it can also be used as a standalone visual enhancement.[/center]
[left][/left]
